Whole photo keeps the proportions with white borders. Dithering uses dots to simulate more shades.
The display must have been powered off and back on. This prevents continuing an incomplete transfer.
Good Display profile · 800 × 480 · four colors. Check the panel label before the first transfer.

1. Connect the display to your phone with a suitable OTG cable/adapter and power supply.

2. Tap Connect USB and allow access.

3. Select a photo or Color test, adjust the preview and tap Send to display. Keep this app open.

4. Wait for the transfer to finish and check the display. Colors and orientation must be confirmed on the physical panel.

If the transfer fails, power the display off and back on before trying again.

Photos are processed on your phone. The app has no internet permission. Logs are exported only when you request it. Choose a local folder in the file picker.
